name: codemode
description: codemode (experimental, full-tilt): run a model-authored JavaScript program whose tools.<name>() calls ride the ordinary tool pipeline (gate, logs, caps); while enabled, shadows the direct tool set (keep-direct list exempt), with in-script discovery (searchTools/describeTool) and head/tail utilities. Opt-in tier: add @experimental to extensionPaths; then codeMode.enabled is the global default (on) and a profile's codeMode bool overrides it per agent.

enabled.description: Global default for the codemode surface (tool, shadow, prompt chunk); a profile's codeMode bool overrides it per agent
